songs.name: Sitting On Top Of The World

supporting_acts: Jack Casady, Jorma Kaukonen, and Joey Covington

ai_show_review.summary: Country‑folk fire with standout Doin' That Rag and Love Light jam
ai_show_review.blurb: The set bursts with pedal‑steel country tunes like Slewfoot, Silver Threads, and Doin’ That Rag, then erupts into a monster Turn On Your Love Light. Jerry’s steel work, Pigpen’s organ blues, and Mickey’s double‑drum drive keep the energy high.
ai_show_review.review: June 28 1969 at Veterans Auditorium captures the Dead in a rare, high‑energy country‑folk mood that predates their psychedelic excesses. From the opening pedal‑steel twang on Slewfoot through the plaintive “Silver Threads And Golden Needles” and the rollicking “Mama Tried,” the band rides a tight groove, with Jerry Garcia swapping his Les Paul for steel and delivering fiery licks on “Doin’ That Rag.” Pigpen’s B‑3 organ adds a gritty blues backbone while Bob Weir’s soulful vocals cut through the acoustic textures. The first half flows smoothly into a blistering second set climax – a monster “Turn On Your Love Light” jam that showcases Mickey Hart’s firecracker double‑drum attack and Bill Kreutzmann’s steady pulse, propelling the group to one of their most exhilarating early jams.

best_recording.reason: Solid soundboard capture with clear mix, pedal‑steel highlights and very listenable audio despite minor cassette hiss.

song_highlights: Sitting On Top Of The World

band_performance.Jerry: Swaps to pedal steel on Slewfoot, Silver Threads and Doin’ That Rag, adds fiery licks on Sitting On Top Of The World and leads vocals on Me And My Uncle.
band_performance.Phil: Bass described as ‘rocking the bass like it’s a baby in his arms,’ providing a solid, propulsive foundation throughout.
band_performance.Bob: Soulful vocal delivery shines on the country numbers, cutting to the core of each tune.
band_performance.Ron: Pigpen’s B‑3 organ work is praised for its bluesy texture that underpins the roots set.
band_performance.Mickey: Double‑drum magic noted as firecracker drums that drive the energetic set and power the Love Light jam.
band_performance.Billy: Provides a tight, steady pulse that locks in with Mickey’s accents, keeping the groove rock solid.

must_listen_sequences: Sitting On Top Of The World
